provenance.method: Reviewed ORR passenger-assistance and Accessible Travel Policy information on 2026-09-05.

name: Office of Rail and Road — passenger assistance
description: Rail-regulator information about Accessible Travel Policies, Passenger Assist and support expected from licensed train/station operators.
intended_use: Inspect Great Britain rail assistance arrangements, including advance booking and turn-up-and-go context.
audience_or_context: Great Britain mainline rail passengers who may need disability, temporary-impairment or age-related assistance.
limitations: Assistance details and station accessibility still vary by operator, station, staffing and disruption.
The regulator route does not guarantee that every requested assistance event will occur exactly as planned.
Northern Ireland rail is outside this GB operator regime.
cost_or_access_notes: Public regulator information; Passenger Assist itself is described as free.
